# Evercraft Circles

Product key: evercraft-circles
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-circles
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-circles/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/evercraft-circles/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- build a trusted professional referral network
- organize a business networking circle
- find a trusted professional through relationship paths
- build a professional roster instead of a social feed
- track referrals and professional introductions
- join a founding professional networking beta

## Authority

public product discovery and human-directed onboarding into a professional networking beta

## Boundaries

- network relationships and referrals are user-directed rather than autonomous endorsements
- joining a Circle does not guarantee business, leads, revenue or successful referrals
- private member profiles, relationship paths, referrals and opportunity data remain access controlled
- external introductions or referrals require appropriate participant authority

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
